name: Jayapriya Anthony
title: Frontend Engineer
tagline: I build frontend systems that go beyond visuals — designed to scale, stay fast, and last.
bio:
With 3+ years in frontend engineering, I focus on modernizing legacy products, crafting high-performance interfaces, and turning complex requirements into clean, maintainable UI. I led a full revamp from Ext.js to Vue 3, built dual-monitor sync using browser APIs, and reduced load time by 30% through targeted refactoring.

I don't just implement UI. I design frontend architecture teams can confidently build on.
about:
I didn't grow into frontend by styling buttons. I grew into it by solving product problems.

Early in my career, I noticed something: most UI issues weren't design problems — they were architecture problems disguised as UI bugs. Slow grids. Unmaintainable components. Legacy frameworks no one wanted to touch.

So I leaned into the hard parts.

I rebuilt products from scratch. Revamped legacy stacks. Created reusable component systems. Worked closely with designers and backend teams to make sure the UI wasn't just visually aligned — but structurally sound.

Today, I'm the developer teams call when:
• A product needs to be rebuilt the right way
• Performance is breaking user experience
• Legacy systems need a modern frontend backbone
• AI tools need to be integrated into real development workflows

I care about one thing: building frontend that survives scale and time.
